_note: Elevated sideline camera standing IN THE PLANE OF THE NET, so the court's long axis runs left-right in the image, the net projects to a single near-vertical line, and both back boundary lines sit at or just outside the 1920 px frame edges. corner_nl/nr/fl/fr are therefore absent by design (D-19: a guessed off-frame corner costs more than a missing one).
